messages:
mina: Quick flag: the new next-modular-eval sample (LlamaIndex + LangChain) shows intermittent 401s under concurrent SSR. Page sometimes hangs while the client keeps retrying.
raj: Which runtime? edge or node?
mina: Edge (default). Minimal handler:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, runtime: 'edge' })
export async function POST(req) { const {q}=await req.json(); return client.generate({model:'open-rw/13b', prompt:q}) }
```
lucy: Do failing responses include x-rw-request-id / retry-after?
mina: Yes, 401 with retry-after: 1 and error invalid_api_key.
raj: Edge client isn't invoking the auth-refresh callback on 401s in concurrent flows. Node got parity earlier.
lucy: Short term: reduce default maxRetries in the sample and recommend server-side token exchange. Also add a tiny parallel-request test in CI.
mina: I'll open a PR with defaultOptions { maxRetries: 1, retryDelayMs: 150 } and the test.
sdk-bot: Created issue SDK-3281: "edge auth refresh parity + SSR retry behavior". Labels: devex, sdk
raj: Long term we should expose an SSR-safe client (no background retries) or make retries opt-in for SSR contexts.
mina: Agreed. PR incoming :thumbsup:
